decided: With sign-off off, the archive's new check reads only the setting and nothing of what the change has kept, so it cannot stop an archive that today completes.
alternatives: read what the change has kept under every setting, and name a stopped archive as a new exception to today's behaviour
why: With every setting at its default, orbit must behave as it does now; a check that only matters under per-change sign-off has no reason to read anything when sign-off is off.
